title: Inspection of the Main Landing Gear Bay Harness Route and Actuator Clearance

ata.title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Landing Gear Bay Wiring

abstract: Inspection of the main landing gear bay harness route, including the clearance to the gear door actuator sweep at three door positions and the insulation check on the door position circuits.

sections.purpose: This task inspects the main landing gear bay harness for insulation damage and measures its clearance to the gear door actuator through a full door cycle.
sections.job_setup_note: The gear must be down and locked with the ground locks fitted and the gear doors held open on the ground props. The clearance measurement is only meaningful if it is taken at the three door positions given in the instructions; a single measurement with the door fully open will always pass and will miss the condition this inspection exists to find.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the aircraft on its wheels with the gear down and locked and install the ground locks. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE GEAR BAY UNTIL THE GROUND LOCKS ARE INSTALLED AND THE GEAR DOORS ARE HELD ON THE GROUND PROPS. 2. Depressurise the green hydraulic system. 3. Get access to zones 145, 572 and 721. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of the harness over the full bay length, with particular attention to the section that crosses the actuator. 5. Record any insulation damage with its position and its extent. 6. Check the terminal block at FIN 1396VC and the bus bar at FIN 622VC7 for security and for corrosion at the terminations. 7. Measure the clearance between the harness and the actuator with the door at the closed, mid and fully open positions, and record all three readings. 8. Compare the smallest reading with the limit on the wiring sheet. 9. Check every cable tie for the correct section and for over-tightening. CAUTION: A CABLE TIE OF THE WRONG SECTION WILL CUT THE HARNESS SLEEVE WITHOUT ANY VISIBLE DAMAGE TO THE OUTER JACKET. REPLACE ANY TIE THAT IS NOT THE SPECIFIED PART. 10. Do an insulation resistance check on the gear door position circuits and record the readings. 11. Check the contactor BED352373-29 mounting for security. 12. Compare the route with drawing D92311222260 and report any difference.
sections.close_out: Remove the ground props and the ground locks only after the bay is clear and the tool count is complete. Record the three clearance readings and the insulation resistance values on the maintenance record. Report any clearance below the limit to engineering before the aircraft is released.

safety_precautions: Install the ground locks and the door ground props before entry.
Replace any cable tie that is not the specified part.

abstract: Inspection of the main landing gear bay harness route, including the clearance to the gear door actuator sweep at three door positions and the insulation check on the door position circuits.

sections.purpose: This task inspects the main landing gear bay harness for insulation damage and measures its clearance to the gear door actuator through a full door cycle.
sections.job_setup_note: The gear must be down and locked with the ground locks fitted and the gear doors held open on the ground props. The clearance measurement is only meaningful if it is taken at the three door positions given in the instructions; a single measurement with the door fully open will always pass and will miss the condition this inspection exists to find. It is also only meaningful once the harness is in its correct position, which is why the cable tie check comes first: a substituted or over-tightened tie holds the harness inboard, and a clearance measured against it is a measurement of the wrong geometry. Correct the ties, let the harness settle, then measure.

Check every cable tie for the correct section and for over-tightening. CAUTION: A CABLE TIE OF THE WRONG SECTION WILL CUT THE HARNESS SLEEVE WITHOUT ANY VISIBLE DAMAGE TO THE OUTER JACKET. REPLACE ANY TIE THAT IS NOT THE SPECIFIED PART. 8. Measure the clearance between the harness and the actuator with the door at the closed, mid and fully open positions, and record all three readings. 9. type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The clearance limit differs pre and post MOD-156940.
